source: runtime capture (SkyZH) 2026-09-10 牲畜棚实测; https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Farmhand (2026-08-24 更新,含 2026-07-22 改版后的鸡宠物任务); fandom 页仍是改版前的附魔面包旧台词,未收
note: Farmhand(农场帮手)是牲畜棚里正在偷懒歇着的雇工,派给玩家做小麦小人、收集作物的入门任务。口气随和、有点懒散(I'm taking a break),对玩家像带新人的老员工;讲收集目标的句子是任务导航,作物名一个不能漏。作为花园访客时的台词也放在这里。「Farmhand」是职务型名字,台词正文里译「农场帮手」,和 Your_Skills.json 的天赋名一致。

messages.text: Welcome to The Barn!
messages.gloss: The Barn → 牲畜棚,沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的地名译法。
messages.zh: 欢迎来到牲畜棚!

messages.raw: Feel free to harvest any crops on the island, I'm taking a break.
messages.text: Feel free to harvest any crops on the island, I'm taking a break.
messages.zh: 岛上的庄稼随便收,我正歇着呢。

messages.raw: Did you craft a §aWheat Minion§f yet? Here's the recipe!
messages.text: Did you craft a Wheat Minion yet? Here's the recipe!
messages.zh: 你做过小麦小人了吗? 配方给你!

messages.text: Nice! I have a Tier X Wheat Minion of my own, maybe one day you can be like me!
messages.gloss: Tier X → 10 档,沿用小人档位的「档」。
messages.zh: 不错! 我自己有一台 10 档的小麦小人,说不定哪天你也能像我这样!

messages.text: While Minions are great, the best way to gather resources is by hand.
messages.zh: 小人是挺好,不过收资源最快的办法还是自己动手。

messages.text: Take this Chicken Pet, it'll help you gather more crops!
messages.zh: 拿着这只鸡宠物,它能帮你多收作物!

messages.text: In order to summon your Chicken Pet, you'll need to add it to your Pets Menu first.
messages.zh: 想召唤鸡宠物,得先把它加进宠物菜单。

messages.text: Hold your Chicken Pet in your hand and right-click to put it in your Pets Menu!
messages.zh: 把鸡宠物拿在手里,右键就能放进宠物菜单!

messages.text: Great! Now go to the SkyBlock Menu and and open up your Pets Menu.
messages.gloss: 原文的 and and 是 Hypixel 的笔误,照实收。
messages.zh: 很好! 现在打开 SkyBlock 菜单,进宠物菜单。

messages.text: From there, find your Chicken Pet and left-click to summon it!
messages.zh: 在里面找到鸡宠物,左键点一下就能召唤!

messages.text: That Chicken Pet gives you  Farming Fortune, which gives you a chance to drop additional crops!
messages.gloss: 早期摘录未含属性图标,另保留社区 Wiki 带图标的写法。
messages.zh: 这只鸡宠物会给你农业时运,有概率多掉作物!

messages.text: Try collecting some of the various crops on the island.
messages.zh: 去岛上各种庄稼都收一点试试。

messages.text: The farm animals here provide a variety of resources.
messages.zh: 这儿的牲畜能出产各种资源。

messages.text: Did you know that chickens drop eggs and cows can be milked?
messages.zh: 你知道吗? 鸡会下蛋,牛还能挤奶。

messages.text: Collect wheat, carrots, potatoes, pumpkins, and melon to add to your Collection and unlock cool rewards!
messages.zh: 收集小麦、胡萝卜、马铃薯、南瓜和西瓜,加进你的收藏品,还能解锁不错的奖励!

messages.text: Those Fairy Souls scare off the animals.
messages.zh: 那些仙女之魂把牲口都吓跑了。

messages.text: Have you been to the Mushroom Desert?
messages.zh: 你去过蘑菇沙漠没?

messages.text: You can find many more types of crops there!
messages.zh: 那边的作物种类多得多!

messages.text: The entrance to the Mushroom Desert sits atop a hill to the north.
messages.zh: 蘑菇沙漠的入口在北边的山顶上。

messages.text: There you'll find resources only an experienced farmer can handle - cocoa beans, sugar cane, mushrooms, and cactus!
messages.zh: 那儿的资源只有老手才玩得转——可可豆、甘蔗、蘑菇,还有仙人掌!

messages.text: You can unlock access by leveling up your Farming Skill to Level V.
messages.zh: 把农业技能练到 5 级就能进去。

messages.text: Reach Farming Skill Level V to unlock access to the Mushroom Desert.
messages.zh: 农业技能练到 5 级,即可解锁蘑菇沙漠。

messages.context: 任务目标为制作小麦小人期间
messages.text: Craft a Wheat Minion!
messages.zh: 做一台小麦小人!

messages.text: Collect 1 of each crop in The Barn to add to your Farming Collection!
messages.zh: 把牲畜棚里的每种作物各收 1 个,加进你的农业收藏品!

messages.text: Collect leather, chicken, and pork to add to your Farming Collection!
messages.zh: 收集皮革、鸡肉和猪肉,加进你的农业收藏品!

messages.text: I took a break from work for too long! Now I need your help to meet my quota!
messages.zh: 我这假摸得有点久了! 现在得靠你帮我把指标凑上!

messages.text: Exactly what I needed. I think I will take the remainder of the day off.
messages.zh: 正是我要的。今天剩下的时间,我看就接着歇了。

messages.text: You condemn me to doing my own work? How can you do this to me!
messages.zh: 你要逼我自己干活? 你怎么能这样对我!

messages.context: 鸡宠物教学;社区 Wiki 的属性图标按 Glyphs 规范写为通用符号
messages.text: That Chicken Pet gives you ☘ Farming Fortune, which gives you a chance to drop additional crops!
messages.gloss: Wiki 原文,未伪造游戏内颜色 raw;分段在运行时采样实际文字颜色。
messages.zh: 这只鸡宠物会给你 ☘ 农业时运,有概率多掉作物!

segments.text: , which gives you a chance to drop additional crops!
